mapper.select: SELECT total_point, total_coupon FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1
SELECT total_point FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(total_point, 0) FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM coupon_purchase WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1))
SELECT DISTINCT stock_id FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')
SELECT name FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}

SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT o.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.buy_order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT publication_price FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}) )

SELECT COALESCE( ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN price * amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)), 0) FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED')

SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.price * o.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) ), 0 ) FROM orders o WHERE (o.student_id = #{studentId} OR o.student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND o.stock_id = #{stockId} AND o.state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY o.stock_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) > 0

SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) * ( (SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT t.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders ord ON t.buy_order_id = ord.order_id WHERE ord.stock_id = o.stock_id ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT s.publication_price FROM stocks s WHERE s.stock_id = o.stock_id) )) - (SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.price * o.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) ) ), 0 ) AS profit FROM orders o WHERE (o.student_id = #{studentId} OR o.student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND o.stock_id = #{stockId} AND o.state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY o.stock_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) > 0

SELECT st.name AS stockName, sub.amount AS amount, sub.current_price AS currentPrice, sub.avg_price AS averagePrice, CAST(ROUND(sub.amount * sub.avg_price) AS SIGNED) AS purchasePrice, CAST(ROUND((sub.amount * sub.current_price) - (sub.amount * sub.avg_price)) AS SIGNED) AS profit FROM ( SELECT o.stock_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.price * o.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS avg_price, COALESCE( (SELECT t.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders ord ON t.buy_order_id = ord.order_id WHERE ord.stock_id = o.stock_id ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT s.publication_price FROM stocks s WHERE s.stock_id = o.stock_id) ) AS current_price FROM orders o WHERE (o.student_id = #{studentId} OR o.student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND o.state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY o.stock_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) > 0 ) sub JOIN stocks st ON sub.stock_id = st.stock_id
